item.description: Savannah Guthrie and her two siblings posted an emotional video, pleading for their missing mother, Nancy Guthrie, to be returned safely.

item.title: Asian shares drop after Wall Street retreats thanks to sinking tech stocks
item.description: Asian shares slipped Thursday after more drops for technology stocks weighed on Wall Street. U.S. futures edged higher and oil prices sank more than $1 a barrel.
